verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets a researcher load many papers as sources, choose which sources to query, ask grounded questions with in-line citations, define custom report types and response styles, and export notes to Google Sheets. Together these allow a manual approximation of screening and extraction, and one community comment calls it useful for structured research workflows. However, nothing documents a dedicated systematic-review workflow, and consistency must be enforced by hand through repeated prompts. Missing for 10: per-paper screening against inclusion/exclusion criteria, structured extraction tables or templates applied uniformly across sources, batch processing of many papers, and hands-on evidence of systematic-review use.
